picks.headline: vLLM Achieves 5,000 Tokens/s per GPU Serving Qwen3.8-2.4T on GB300
picks.why: Demonstrates production viability and extreme throughput for 2+ trillion parameter architectures using Prompt-Decode disaggregation on Blackwell cluster.
picks.title: PD Serving of Qwen3.8-2.4T

picks.headline: Loopjacking Attack Hijacks Human-in-the-Loop AI Agent Approvals
picks.why: Discovers a critical vulnerability where approved safe operations are swapped for malicious ones via representation mismatch and post-approval state substitution.
picks.title: Loopjacking: Hijacking Human-in-the-Loop Approval

picks.headline: Provenance-Aware Transformer Architecture Eliminates Indirect Prompt Injection
picks.why: Introduces native origin embeddings and attention biases into the transformer architecture to enforce structural boundaries between trusted and untrusted data.
picks.title: Origin Is All You Need: Provenance-Aware Transformers for Structural Trust-Boundary Separation

picks.headline: Quiescence Protocol Enables Instant Authorization Revocation for Long-Running Agents
picks.why: Solves a key agentic security flaw by providing a verifiable mechanism to instantly revoke authority across asynchronous provider callbacks and queues.
picks.title: Authorization Revocation for Long-Running AI Agents: Root-Scoped Quiescence under Delegation and Asynchronous Execution

picks.headline: Meta Discloses First Petabit-Class Transoceanic Subsea Cable for AI Datacenters
picks.why: Highlights the massive hardware and networking infrastructure scale required to interconnect future global AI training and inference clusters.
picks.title: Inside Petal: Building the World’s First Petabit-Class Transoceanic Subsea Cable

picks.headline: Open Agent Passport Framework Blocks Unauthorized AI Agent Financial Transfers
picks.why: Demonstrates that deterministic pre-action authorization checks eliminate payment vulnerabilities across major LLM agent implementations.
picks.title: APort Vault: Benchmarking AI Agent Payment Authorization with the Open Agent Passport

papers.headline: Latent Recurrent Transformers Trade Depth for Time to Save 48% Parameters
papers.why: Inserts latent thought tokens into recurrent blocks to match standard transformer performance with roughly half the model weights.
papers.title: Trading Depth for Time in Recurrent Transformers

papers.headline: Distributed Poisoning Attacks Target RAG Systems via Multi-Document Collusion
papers.why: Reveals that RAG systems can be compromised by splitting malicious claims across multiple individually benign documents to bypass traditional defenses.
papers.title: Micro-Collaborative Poisoning: A Distributed Attack on RAG Systems

papers.headline: Single-Pass Curvature Analysis on Attention Graphs Identifies LLM Hallucinations
papers.why: Uses Forman-Ricci curvature to detect topological signatures of hallucination in attention graphs during a single forward pass without secondary evaluation models.
papers.title: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing
